messages:
Carmen (SE): FYI customer HelioBank sent an SQ this morning asking for RBAC change audit evidence + KMS rotation logs. They want a 3rd-party-friendly export for tomorrow's call.
Alice (InfoSec): Ack. Do we have a standard artifact set for this? retention + chain-of-custody notes?
Ben (SRE): We have the audit export script but need to confirm it includes role-change events + service account ops. Current script: 
```
/scripts/export_audit.sh --tenant=heliobank --since=90d --types=auth,roles,kms --out=/tmp/helio-audit.tar.gz
```
Carmen (SE): Perfect. Helio specifically asked for proof that tenant RBAC changes are scoped and immutable (audit chain) and that KMS keys are rotated and envelope-wrapped. They also asked whether logs are forwarded to customer SIEM.
Jake (Infra): We don't forward tenant logs to customer SIEM by default (privacy). We can provide redacted log bundles or set up a webhook/forwarder on Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted customers, we provide signed export bundles and an MD5 + signed manifest.
Priya (Solutions): Can we produce a short README for the bundle that explains fields and redaction policy? Helio will hand this to their auditors.
Alice (InfoSec): Yes please. The README should include: generation command, manifest (SHA256 checksums), signing principal, redaction list, retention window, and contact for chain-of-custody queries.
Ben (SRE): I can generate a manifest and sign with our audit key. sec-bot will append a tamper-proof log entry. sec-bot: export job queued: job-id=jb-20260321-42 tenant=heliobank
sec-bot: job started by Ben (SRE) at 2026-03-21T14:12:03Z
Carmen (SE): One Helio ask: can we show the KMS rotation event and the wrapping key lineage? They specifically asked for evidence of key rotation in the last 12 months + HSM provenance for on-prem pilot.
Jake (Infra): For hosted KMS we can include: rotation event log (kms.rotation.*), key metadata (key-id, created_at, rotated_at), and envelope chain entries. For HSM-onprem we have to coordinate with ops to pull HSM audit (different system). I'll ping ops.
Alice (InfoSec): Also confirm whether rotation is automatic or manual per-customer. Helio will mark this as a control in their SOC-type review.
Priya (Solutions): Add a short blurb: "Rotation policy: default 90d; customer can opt-in to managed rotation with HSM-backed keys (Dedicated/Private)." Can legal/infra confirm wording?
Ben (SRE): Adding: we log who initiated rotation (svc account or human) in the audit export.
Carmen (SE): Another Helio QA: RBAC change approval flow — they want screenshots or a short video of the approval steps + system log evidence when an admin elevates a user.
Alice (InfoSec): We should avoid screenshots with PII. Provide sanitized screenshots + the matching audit events. Event example: `ROLE_CHANGE` {actor: svc-admin-42, target: user:helio-admin, from: viewer, to: admin, ts: 2026-01-11T09:22:33Z}
Ben (SRE): I'll include that event line in the bundle. We'll redact email addresses but keep unique ids.
Jake (Infra): Ops responded: HSM export for pilot is scheduled tomorrow 08:00 PT — may be slightly delayed. If Helio needs the HSM provenance in-call, we should surface the signed manifest and commit to follow up with HSM logs within 48h.
Carmen (SE): Good call. I'll tell Helio we'll deliver the initial bundle before the call and HSM artifacts as follow-up if needed.
Priya (Solutions): Timeline: Ben to produce bundle + README by EOD today, Jake to confirm HSM export ETA, Alice to write short attestation email template (security@redwood) for the manifest signature.
Ben (SRE): Working on it now. Export in progress, will post location when done.
sec-bot: export job completed: job-id=jb-20260321-42 out=/secure/exports/helio-audit-20260321.tar.gz checksum=sha256:3f7a9b... signed-by=redwood-audit-key
Ben (SRE): Bundle ready: /secure/exports/helio-audit-20260321.tar.gz (permissions: internal/sec, signed manifest included)
Carmen (SE): Sharing with customer now. Note: Helio also asked about vuln triage history for a prior CVE (CVE-2025-9999) — status and mitigation timeline.
Alice (InfoSec): Short summary: CVE-2025-9999 patched 2025-06-10, mitigation included CVE fix + config hardening. We have a public advisory entry + internal triage notes. Do we want to include redacted triage notes or a summary? I suggest summary + timeline.
Priya (Solutions): Helio will likely accept a short timeline + patch ver + verification steps. No need for internal deliberations.
Carmen (SE): Agreed. I'll attach the timeline and the signed bundle link in the call materials. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Jake (Infra): Ops ETA for HSM export: 2026-03-22T08:30Z. I'll update the thread when it's uploaded.
Alice (InfoSec): I'll prepare the attestation email template now and drop it here.
Carmen (SE): Awesome — closing the loop. If anything changes ping me or @here in this thread.
